name: Device (Serial/Parallel)
description: Serial / parallel monitor panel + Device Manager (bind/rebind/unbind @alias with node-impact confirmation) + discovered-port picker + comm send + parallel write with payload preview (byte/float32/string) and configurable pulse width + extension-owned @alias registry (Application.Core.DeviceAliases capability) - official example extension

runtime.note: pyserial is part of the base runtime image; declared so a future base trim cannot silently break the node pack
